title: MSCI India Hackathon 2022 Winners (3rd Prize)
description:
Knowledge Nexus: Breaking Down Barriers in the Workplace

Knowledge Nexus is a user-friendly search app designed to enhance collaboration and connection among employees. Here's what it offers:

- Skill-Based Search: Easily find colleagues based on their skills and business knowledge.
- Team Collaboration: Foster teamwork by bridging gaps between different departments.
- Inclusive Culture: Encourage an open environment where everyone can contribute and learn.
- Diverse Connections: Connect with individuals who have varied skill sets for shared learning.
- Centralized Employee Information: Access all employee-related information in one place.

Why Choose Knowledge Nexus?
- Adapting to Remote Work: As remote work reduces interactions between teams, Knowledge Nexus helps maintain connections that were once common in the office.
- Finding Expertise Made Easy: The app addresses the challenge of locating individuals with specific skills or knowledge when you need assistance.
- Streamlined Recommendations: It simplifies the year-end recommendation process, especially for managers overseeing large teams.

 Our team was proud to be ranked 3rd out of 85 ideas, with 30 teams shortlisted for participation. We utilized Azure Cosmos DB and React JS to develop this solution.
Knowledge Nexus aims to solve workplace challenges by creating a platform that promotes collaboration and knowledge sharing among employees.

title: MSCI Global T&D AI Hackathon 2024
description:
AI Xtractor: Simplifying Document Processing

AI Xtractor is an innovative app that makes it easy to extract information from documents. Instead of manually filling out forms, users can simply scan their documents, and the app displays the extracted data in a clear grid format. This saves time and reduces the effort needed for data entry.

We started with two apps: one for storing documents and another for filling out forms. To connect these, we used AI technology to create a smooth workflow.

Key Benefits:

- Quick Data Extraction: Users can upload their documents and get the information they need extracted from them.
- Easy Review Process: The extracted data is shown in a grid, allowing users to check and accept the information easily.
- Time-Saving: This automation speeds up the process and minimizes errors, making it more efficient for everyone involved.

AI Xtractor is designed to enhance productivity and improve the overall experience for users by simplifying document handling.
